PhD forms are submitted to Tim Langreder.1@osu.edu, PhD Coordinator who will manage approvals from the ECE Graduate Studies Committee. He will contact students once review/approval is complete, or if there are any questions or other items needed.
MS forms that need Graduate Studies Committee approval are submitted to Beth Bucher.9@osu.edu who will manage approvals and notify the student when complete or if there are questions.
